label: sdc01_0430_ogre_01
text: Grrr...

label: sdc01_0430_sister_01
text: Eesh... You really don’t want to be here, do you?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0430_brother_01
text: D-don’t worry! It’ll be fine![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0430_sister_02
text: Kiki! What’s this all about, really?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0430_brother_02
text: I-I know you must be scared, Ogerpon, but I\ndid my best...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0430_brother_03
text: So...just trust me and come with me, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0430_people_01
text: So that’s the ogre, Ogerpon...

label: sdc01_0430_people_02
text: It’s actually real?!

label: sdc01_0430_ogre_02
text: Gah... Grah...

label: sdc01_0430_select_01
text: Don’t worry

label: sdc01_0430_select_02
text: Let’s trust Kieran

label: sdc01_0430_caretaker_01
text: So this is the ogre of Oni Mountain...[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0430_caretaker_02
text: This is the true face of Ogerpon, whom we’ve so\nsorely wronged![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0430_caretaker_03
text: For far too long, we’ve told tales casting you as\nthe villain here in Kitakami...[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0430_caretaker_04
text: We all owe you a great apology.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0430_ogre_03
text: Poni?!

label: sdc01_0430_sister_03
text: Hey, what’s going on?! Why the sudden\nabout-face?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0430_gfather_01
text: Kieran’s been running around the whole village,\ntelling everyone the true story of what happened.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0430_gfather_02
text: I was worried he’d stir up a lot of resentment,\nso I told him to stop, but...[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0430_people_03
text: We’re so sorry, dear ogre!

label: sdc01_0430_people_04
text: Ogerpon’s so cute!

label: sdc01_0430_gfather_03
text: Seems that I was wrong to worry so much.[VAR 0x0114(0030)]

label: sdc01_0430_sister_04
text: Who knew Kiki had it in him! Especially since he\nusually hates talking to people![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0430_brother_04
text: From now on, you can come to the village\nwhenever you want...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0430_brother_05
text: and you don’t need to hide your face when\nyou do![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0430_ogre_04
text: Pon-yo!

label: sdc01_0430_caretaker_05
text: The three masks we kept at Kitakami Hall\nrightfully belonged to you all along.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0430_caretaker_06
text: If you’ve managed to get them back from those\nthree villains, please feel welcome to keep them.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0430_sister_06
text: We got the masks back, and we managed to\nclear Ogerpon’s name![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0430_sister_07
text: Now that’s what I call a happy ending![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0430_sister_08
text: One last thing to do—let’s escort Ogerpon back\nto its home![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0430_caretaker_07
text: We truly wronged Ogerpon...\c\nFrom now on, we’ll be sure to pass down the true\nversion of events in our town.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
